about.storyLead: Mbuyamba Education is a digital learning environment designed to make learning clearer, more concrete, and more engaging.
about.storyParagraphOne: The platform brings together lessons, interactive activities, exercises, educational games, challenges, and revision paths in one experience. Students can discover a concept, explore it in different ways, practise, try again when needed, and progress step by step.
about.storyParagraphTwo: Mbuyamba favours active and progressive learning. Reading an explanation is only the beginning: students are encouraged to observe, think, manipulate, try, and apply what they have just understood. The same concept can be approached in several ways to support understanding and memory.
about.storyParagraphThree: Each learning path also leaves room for autonomy. Students can move at their own pace, return to a difficulty, go deeper into a concept, or choose another activity to keep learning. Our ambition is to create a space where understanding matters as much as getting the right answer, where mistakes become opportunities to try differently, and where progress remains visible and encouraging.
about.storyQuote: Learning can be serious without being boring.
about.imageAlt: A teacher supports students using tablets and computers in a modern classroom.
about.imageCaption: Digital tools used to support students and teachers.
about.howLead: Your path starts wherever you need it to. Come to discover something new, review, practise, or learn through play.

choose.title: Choose your path
choose.description: Pick your grade, an activity, an educational game, or EXETAT preparation depending on your goal for the day.

learn.title: Discover and understand
learn.description: Explore concepts step by step, with examples and situations designed to make learning more concrete.

practice.title: Practise and play
practice.description: Test what you understand with interactive exercises and challenges. Here, play is part of learning.

progress.title: Progress at your own pace
progress.description: Return to a difficult idea, repeat an activity, and gradually build your learning journey. The goal is not to go fast, but to understand.

about.paceText: You do not have to do everything in a fixed order: follow a lesson, practise, use a game to strengthen an idea, then return wherever you need to.
about.visionLead: In a school, Mbuyamba can be used in different ways depending on available equipment and the teacher's choices. An activity can be presented to the whole class on a screen or interactive board, completed in small groups on tablets, or assigned individually on a computer.
about.visionParagraphOne: But Mbuyamba is more than a place to display content. It creates one shared working environment around the teacher, the student, and the family.

teacher.title: The teacher
teacher.description: can organise students into groups, assign an activity to a whole class, a group, or an individual student, then follow results and progress from their own space.

student.title: The student
student.description: sees assigned activities, knows what work needs to be completed, can resume an activity, and follows progress in the same place as lessons, exercises, and games.

parent.title: The parent
parent.description: can view their child's progress, see completed activities, and better understand the concepts that still need attention.

about.visionConclusion: At school and at home, the student therefore finds the same learning environment and the same familiar reference points.
about.promiseText: An activity started in class can be found again at home. Students keep their activities, assigned work, and progress in a familiar environment, while teachers and parents each have a view suited to their role.
about.promiseQuote: One environment to learn in class, continue at home, and follow the student's progress.
about.closing: Learn. Explore. Try. Try again. Progress.
